# Poop Profit

> Free web app that calculates and tracks how much money you get paid while pooping at work. It reveals earnings you already make on the clock; it never pays users or helps them earn more.

## What it does

- Live session timer: enter your pay, start the timer when you sit down, watch earnings tick up in real time
- Session log and analytics: totals, averages, longest sessions, best-earning days
- Shareable stat card to send to coworkers
- Turd Tokens: a daily reward for logging a session, with streak bonuses. Not a cryptocurrency, not an investment. Redeemable for Poop Profit merch in the future
- Mascot: Herman, the fictional poop CEO

## Access

- Guests can use the timer and calculator instantly, no account required
- A free account (Google sign-in or email magic link) saves every session, syncs across devices, and unlocks analytics and Turd Tokens
